  line 6: [side-tab] border-r-4
    → Thick colored border on one side of a card — the most recognizable tell of AI-generated UIs. Use a subtler accent or remove it entirely.
  line 17: [side-tab] border-right: 4px solid #8b5cf6
    → Thick colored border on one side of a card — the most recognizable tell of AI-generated UIs. Use a subtler accent or remove it entirely.
  line 19: [overused-font] font-family: 'Roboto
    → Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.
  line 7: [ai-color-palette] text-purple-500 on heading
    → Purple/violet gradients and cyan-on-dark are the most recognizable tells of AI-generated UIs. Choose a distinctive, intentional palette.
  line 10: [bounce-easing] animate-bounce (Tailwind)
    → Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.
  line 30: [bounce-easing] animation: elastic
    → Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.
  line 31: [layout-transition] transition: height
    → Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.
  line 26: [gradient-text] background-clip: text + gradient
    → Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text.
